## the Setup tab's actions (each on a fresh page; its requests)
  Pick them (step 1, a new process with positions) → tab setup, sheet "Edit process" · GET /api/core-nodes, GET …/payloads, GET /api/process-nodes, GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes, GET /api/operator-stations/12/claimed-nodes, GET …/routing-nodes, GET /api/payload-catalog, GET /api/process-nodes
  Start (step 2, a routing set and no style: one is made, named by the first part) → tab setup (style step) · POST /api/styles {"name":"PART-1","description":"","process_id":1,"expected_catid":""}, GET /api/processes, GET …/composer?map_rev=map-r1, GET …/styles, POST …/flow/preview
  Start (step 2, a style with no flow yet) → tab setup (style step) · POST …/flow/preview
  Production counter (Later, on Settings) → tab settings · GET …/routing-nodes, GET /api/process-nodes, GET /api/payload-catalog, GET …/payloads, GET …/station-counters, GET …/counting-slots, GET …/catid-health, GET /api/plcs, GET …/presets, GET …/auto-reorder, GET /api/core-nodes
